signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 2 US offices
2 new PM roles posted this week

bullets: Own agent architecture and configuration, including prompts, intents, conversation flows, tool calls, extensions, transfer protocols, and retrieval-augmented knowledge bases.
Lead technical discovery to translate customer business processes, rules, exceptions, and handoffs into agent behavior.
Build agents that handle real healthcare complexity, including scheduling logic, patient context, EHR data, and practice-specific requirements.
Partner with Engineering on integrations, new features, and end-to-end testing, translating integration constraints into agent design decisions.
Assess technical feasibility and help the Customer Delivery PM understand implementation effort and tradeoffs before scope and timelines are committed.
